Refactor mention feature in bite command

Removed direct dependency for MentionUser and UserIdMention in the bite command, and replaced the implementation with a formatted string. This makes mention feature more straightforward and reduces dependency clutter in the code. Future potential changes to MentionUser or UserIdMention will not affect this bite functionality.

Update dependencies in Cargo.toml

Removed 'auto-send' feature from the 'teloxide' dependency. Commented out 'surrealdb' library and added 'octocrab'. These changes are done to align libraries better with the current project requirements and to get rid of unused or unnecessary features.
Remove Cargo.lock for reboot purposes.

"Refactor imports in dependencies.rs for better readability"

In this commit, the import statements in src/utils/dependencies.rs have been reformatted for improved readability. The modules from the teloxide and teloxide_core libraries have been listed individually rather than in a single line. This should make it easier to ascertain what exact modules are being imported.

Remove redundant chat member status checks

The redundant checks of chat member statuses in `src/commands/testing.rs` were removed. These checks were unnecessary and not contributing to the logic, as their respective banning, unbanning, and muting functions are already handling user statuses properly. This clean-up leads to more streamlined and readable code.

Refactor main.rs for user mention and chat member handling

Removed unused code for the `MentionUser` trait and the `UserIdMention` struct. Replaced the MarkdownV2 parse mode with ParseMode::Html. Reworked the `chat_member_welcome` function to handle both chat member entrance and exit using `ChatMemberUpdated`s status. The previous implementation was redundant and hard to maintain, this change will streamline the code and improve maintainability.

"Add MarkdownV2 parsing to bot messages"

This commit adds MarkdownV2 parsing to the bot's response messages. Previously, the bot would send plain text messages which doesn't allow for formatting such as bold or italic text. With the addition of MarkdownV2 parsing, the bot's messages can now include more complex text formatting. This change aims to improve the readability and presentation of the bot's messages.
